title: Controller regression (v3.0 F3)
rules: A row is one journey (its --model class filter), one scenario (its declared class) or one script.
model: judged = the verdict depends on what the model writes (GPU every run); any = plumbing around a real call; none = no model call (no-model lane).

controller: true = the row's verdict depends on the controller under test (server semantics, timing, VRAM). Such an any row runs live once per adopted change with st-lanes batch --record, and every repeat or rerun on the same controller rides --replay. controller: false any rows ride --replay from an existing recording.
gpu: true on a script row = it needs the GPU (or ComfyUI) whatever the class.
new: true = a check written for F3 (scripts/debug/so-controller-checks.mts or a v30-f3 scenario); missing: true = named by the audit, not written yet.
branch = the row's target lives on that branch until it merges.
args (journey rows only) = the journey arm flags (--judge-uses, --warden-mode) the row runs with; the batch item becomes "<target> <args>".
Mocked (none) rows never reach the controller; they stay in a list as no-model sanity for the same feature, never as controller evidence.
